events.summary: Scoped strictly to internal/agent (resolveFromSnapshot signature, watch.go enqueue, reconcile_queue.go reconcileItem/enqueue/process, agent.go ensureQuotaWith/ensureQuota), test pinning in internal/agent/audit_correlation_test.go, design doc residual gap update in docs/quotapolicy-design.md, and eval trace. Deliberately NOT touched: quota apply comparison logic, shrink guard semantics, ensureQuotaMutated return semantics, internal/quota, RBAC, or CRD fields.

Confirmed defect: watch-triggered enforcement audit entries carried no QuotaPolicy provenance, so half of all attempts could not be joined to the policy that shaped them. Structural inspection confirmed that resolveFromSnapshot in internal/agent/policy.go discarded the winning policy and BoundDecision (returning only int64), watch.go enqueued only effectiveBytes without policy provenance, and reconcile_queue.go's reconcileItem held no policyAttempt, calling ensureQuota which passed nil policyAttempt to ensureQuotaMutatedWith.

Updated resolveFromSnapshot in internal/agent/policy.go to return (effectiveBytes int64, winner *v1alpha1.QuotaPolicy, decision quotapolicy.BoundDecision); updated watch.go to construct &policyAttempt{winner: winner, decision: decision} when winner != nil and pass it to rq.enqueue; updated reconcileItem in reconcile_queue.go to hold policyAttempt; updated reconcile_queue.go process to call ensureQuotaWith(ctx, item.pv, item.effectiveBytes, item.policyAttempt); added ensureQuotaWith to agent.go delegating to ensureQuotaMutatedWith with pa; updated docs/quotapolicy-design.md residual gap text.

Deliberate breakage and restoration: temporarily changed watch.go to pass nil instead of pa to rq.enqueue. TestWatchPath_PolicyProvenanceRecordedWhenPolicyApplies failed with 'expected Policy provenance to be recorded when a QuotaPolicy clamped the claim on the watch path' at audit_correlation_test.go:687. Restored rq.enqueue(pv, effectiveBytes, pa) and confirmed all watch-path tests pass: (1) TestWatchPath_PolicyProvenanceRecordedWhenPolicyApplies passes with expected Outcome (BoundClampedToMax); (2) TestWatchPath_PolicyProvenanceAbsentWithoutMatchingPolicy passes with Policy == nil; (3) TestWatchPath_SnapshotRefreshBetweenResolveAndApply_RecordsResolvedPolicy passes confirming the policy actually used is recorded even if the snapshot is refreshed before apply; (4) TestWatchPath_PolicyProvenanceRecordedOnUpdate passes with UPDATE action; (5) TestWatchPath_PolicyProvenanceRecordedOnVerifyFailed passes with VERIFY_FAILED action.
